newsitem.title: UK: Gasoline edges up $1 but NWE products mostly quiet.
newsitem.headline: Gasoline edges up $1 but NWE products mostly quiet.

text.p: Gasoline edged $1 a tonne higher in early trading in Europe but most other products were little changed in sluggish trading.
Brokers said Rotterdam refinery product was bid at $193.50 but offered no better than $195.50. "It has moved up a bit but its quiet," said a broker.
May swaps were bid at $195.25 with offers at $198. Gas oil was just 50 cents a tonne higher on the IPE but premiums were unchanged. Heavy fuel barges were unchanged around $81.50 for April barges.
